end.parentNote: Sameer practised place-value multiplication and used splitting to calculate 50 × 12 as 600. They also asked how to round to the nearest ten. The doubling-and-halving method was mixed up once and was not fully corrected in the lesson. At home, practise examples such as 25 × 16 by doubling one factor and halving the other, then check the product.
